jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE full-body Santa Claus character sprite for the Magic Mail mobile game. Reference image 1 is the approved adult postman: use his artist's expressive Crash Bandicoot-inspired proportions, crooked angular shapes, oversized hands and boots, strong readable silhouette and clean stylized painted shading. Do NOT turn Santa into that young postman or copy the postman's clothes. Reference image 2 is the red shrub: use its broad smooth saturated gradients and large creamy glossy highlights as the surface finish, not its foliage geometry. Keep detail restrained: large clean masses, no fine hair strands, fur fibers, fabric grain or tiny decoration. Santa is an ELDERLY HUMAN with a big expressive nose, large white moustache and beard grouped into 3 or 4 simple chunky locks, warm skin, a round belly, a crooked floppy red Santa cap with cream trim and one pompom, red coat, a broad dark belt and one chunky simple gold buckle, cream cuffs, oversized mittens and broad sturdy brown boots. Both feet share one standing ground line. Full body from hat to boot soles visible, front three-quarter view suitable for a map prop, clear transparent margin on all four sides. Thin warm ivory outer contour matching the postman, dark local-color internal contours. True TRANSPARENT background, alpha zero outside the outline. No halo, glow, ground patch, baked cast shadow, scenery, lettering, logos, UI or watermark. Only ONE character, no companion, no extra separate objects. Personality and pose: GOOD, warm and cheerful Santa, smiling with friendly raised eyebrows, big lively eyes, broad chest and stocky whimsical body, one mitten raised in an open welcoming wave and the other resting on his belt. Relaxed confident stance with boots apart, asymmetry and cartoon charm, vivid warm Christmas red, amber-gold accents and creamy ivory beard. Broad soft gloss on the nose, hat and coat, same polished painting as the references. No weapons, no extra ornaments or heavy accessories.
